overview.zh-Hans: 该模块用于在阿里云 Stack 上创建表格存储(OTS)实例和表，支持VPC附件、动态主键定义和目录配额管理。
overview.en-US: This module is used to create Table Store (OTS) instances and tables on Alibaba Cloud Stack, supporting VPC attachment, dynamic primary key definitions, and directory quota management.

description.zh-Hans: 用于创建OTS实例、表格和VPC附件的Terraform模块
description.en-US: Terraform module for creating OTS instances, tables, and VPC attachments
